title: Astrid & William
subtitle: Full Wedding Stationary Suite Design
desc:
For Astrid and Will’s wedding stationery, the goal was to capture the effortless romance of an Italian summer: elegant enough to feel like an occasion, relaxed enough to feel like them.

Drawing inspiration from the timeless romance of Lake Como and sun-drenched Tuscan estates, I designed a suite that channels old-world European opulence while staying light and easy-going, in keeping with their lakeside venue. I worked with the couple through mood boards, drafts and revisions, shaping every detail around their story and the setting.

The final suite uses a palette pulled directly from the villa’s natural gardens and stone terraces: soft dusty blue, earthy terracotta, and pops of fresh lemon yellow. Together they set the tone for the day before the first guest arrived: warm, sunlit and unmistakably theirs.
details:
ROLE: Designer
TIMELINE: March - May 2026
TOOLS: Illustrator, Photoshop
PIECES: Custom monograms, invitation cards, RSVP cards, table place cards, table numbers, food & drink menus, wine labels, food packaging, coasters and hand fans
